text:
As a QA Automation Engineer at Evertz India, you will be part of a team dedicated to delivering high-quality, reliable software solutions that power broadcast technology globally. This role offers the opportunity to contribute to software quality through test automation, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and support continuous improvement in a dynamic, technology-driven environment spanning India and Canada.

 As part of the Overture QA team, you will:

• Test complex software

• Maintain and extend the automated test suite

• Write and execute automated tests

• Analyze test failures and report bugs

• Work with Development to increase automated test coverage across the product

• Contribute programs/procedures to improve testing efficiency

 Role Responsibilities 

• Developing new automated test cases

• Maintaining existing automated test cases

• Analyzing test failures

• Reviewing test source code

• Gaining thorough understanding of broadcast industry standards and specifications

• Collaborating with developers to test bug fixes

• Writing documentation for automated tests

• Writing reports and reporting bugs to a high standard

• Working with QA team members based in India and Canada

 Essential Skills 

• Strong Python programming skills

• Proven test automation experience

• Proven analytical/problem-solving skills

• Linux systems administration experience

• Excellent written English and verbal communication skills

 Role Requirements 

• 3 to 5 years of proven working experience as a QA engineer

• Knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodology

• Familiarity with software testing processes (ISTQB Foundation, or equivalent experience)

• Ability to work with Windows and Linux (Ubuntu) OS; system administrator-level skills would be a plus

• Experience with bash coding

• Willingness to learn a huge system with hardware and software interactions

• Time management and organization skills

• Familiarity with AWS

 Office Timing: 4pm to 12.30am IST 
 Work Model: Remote /Hybrid
Office Location: Manyata Tech Park, Bangalore, India

 About Evertz Microsystems (TSX: ET) 
Evertz India is the subsidiary of Evertz Microsystems (TSX:ET) a global leader in broadcast technology, delivering cutting-edge hardware and software solutions that deliver content to television sets, on-demand services, WebTV, IPTV, and mobile devices (like phones and tablets) worldwide. Trusted by major broadcast facilities, telcos, and satellite providers on every continent, we're known for end-to-end innovation that sets the industry standard. Canadian-headquartered with offices around the world, Evertz has 2,000+ employees and has been recognized as one of Canada's 50 Best Managed Companies — a testament to our commitment to excellence and global impact. Join a team where your work shapes the future of broadcast and new media industries.

 The Perks 

• Flexible working opportunities

• In-house knowledge and product training

• Exposure to global broadcast and media platforms

• Performance-related bonuses

• Insurance and medical plans

• Employee-friendly leave policy

 Your Growth 
At Evertz, your career is a path to growth and achievement, not just a job. We encourage you to seize opportunities, push boundaries, and pursue your goals.
We offer a hybrid/remote model that balances flexibility and collaboration, driving innovation through diversity, adaptability, and strong connections. You’ll join an inclusive, dynamic team that values creativity and fresh ideas.
Culture is central at Evertz we welcome diverse, passionate talent ready to shape the future. Join us on this journey. Apply now!
